summary.text: David Rose is a Republican candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is also an at-large member of the Lake Havasu Unified School District governing board, with a term ending in 2028, and advanced from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
